ios.desc:
Yoa is the everything Health app: sleep, recovery, strain, HRV, workouts, daily insights and the small habits that quietly shape how you feel, all in one calm, friendly place.

From restorative sleep and morning readiness to honest training load and the daily choices that move the needle, Yoa transforms your Apple Health data into personalized guidance you can actually use. Whether you're chasing a personal best, getting back on your feet after burnout, or just trying to feel a little better day to day, Yoa helps you train smarter, recover deeper, and finally understand your body without the noise.

Works with everything you already wear. Apple Watch, Garmin, Coros, Whoop, Polar, Withings, Eight Sleep, Pillow, AutoSleep and many more — anything that writes to Apple Health.

FEATURES

Body Score: Your daily readiness, in one number. Yoa combines your sleep, recovery and strain into a single Body Score so you know at a glance whether today is a day to push, hold steady, or take it easy.

Recovery Score: A Whoop-style readiness signal built around your HRV and resting heart rate. Yoa benchmarks every reading against your own personal baseline so you stop comparing yourself to textbook averages and start tracking what is actually normal for you.

Sleep Quality: One clear number for how restored you really are. Yoa analyses your duration, sleep stages, restorative sleep and overall quality, and respects a personal sleep goal so the score reflects what you are aiming for.

Strain Score: See exactly how hard you've worked your body each day. Yoa folds workouts, active calories and effort into a single, honest strain score so you can train hard without burning out.

Health Monitor: A live, glanceable dashboard of the six metrics that matter most: Respiratory Rate, Resting Heart Rate, HRV, Blood Oxygen, Wrist Temperature and Sleep Duration. Each tile is color-coded against your own baseline. Tap any tile for a 10-day chart with your personal safe band drawn in.

Daily Suggestions: Each morning Yoa surfaces a handful of personal observations about you ("In the past 5 nights your respiratory rate was low 3 times", "You missed your sleep goal", "Recovery is trending down") with the data and the action right next to each other.

Smart Journal: Know how life shapes health. Tap the habits that matter to you — caffeine, alcohol, late meals, cold showers, breathwork, creatine, blackout curtains, anything — and Yoa correlates them with your sleep, recovery and HRV over the

quotes.text:
Hi everyone!  I’m Luka, an indie developer, and I’m excited to share Yoa with you—a personal orange companion designed to make tracking your health easy and fun.

I created Yoa because I struggled with sleep, constant fatigue, stress, and overtraining. I needed something to simplify my wellbeing journey, and Yoa was born from that need.

What makes Yoa awesome?
- Simple wellbeing dashboard with Yoa’s friendly touch
- Personalized insights to improve sleep, fitness, and reduce stress
- Detailed workout breakdowns and clear activity charts

Yoa has helped me feel more in control of my health, and I hope it can do the same for you! If you have an Apple Watch, it’s the perfect companion to track your wellbeing seamlessly. I’d love to hear your thoughts—what features would you like to see? Your feedback means the world to me!

Let’s make health tracking personal and fun!
